reason: All three Discovery pipelines resolved their due P0 coverage. Twenty-two material same-day signals were normalized without topic selection: six AI-platform signals and sixteen GitHub-engineering signals; no same-day published-research signal met the retention threshold.
reason_zh: 三条 Discovery 管线均完成 P0 到期来源覆盖。本日规范化保留 22 个实质性同日信号，未执行选题：AI 平台 6 个、GitHub 工程 16 个；论文与研究成果管线没有发现达到保留阈值的同日信号。

pipelines.label_zh: AI 平台变更情报发现

failed.reason: The registered public Cursor Announcements section returned an internal retrieval error during this run; the failure is recorded rather than treated as checked.

pipelines.reason: All 45 due public channels were resolved as 44 checked plus one explicit retrieval failure. Claude Code v2.1.247 supplied the retained same-day platform changes.
pipelines.reason_zh: 45 个到期公共通道全部收口：44 个已检查，1 个明确记录抓取失败。保留的同日平台变化来自 Claude Code v2.1.247。

pipelines.reason: All nine P0 daily repositories were checked incrementally. Retained changes came from OpenAI Codex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Gemini CLI and Google ADK; inactive repositories had no retained same-day mechanism change.
pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 Daily 仓库均完成增量检查。保留变化来自 OpenAI Codex、OpenAI Agents SDK、Gemini CLI 与 Google ADK；其余仓库没有保留符合条件的同日机制变化。

pipelines.reason: All nine P0 research sources were resolved as eight checked plus one explicit retrieval failure; no material research object published on the run date met the retention threshold.
pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 研究来源全部收口：8 个已检查，1 个明确记录抓取失败；未发现发表于运行日且达到保留阈值的实质研究对象。

columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 10 个以数字员工为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: Discovery recorded two primary Industry Architecture signals; Queue owns scoring and selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 2 个以行业架构为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: Discovery recorded ten primary Open-source Engineering signals; Queue owns scoring and selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 10 个以开源工程为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

signals.title: Claude Code sub-agents now use the session fallback model chain after a first-call model 404
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 子 Agent 首次模型调用 404 后改用会话回退模型链
signals.summary: A sub-agent no longer dies immediately on a first-call model 404; it follows the session fallback chain and returns structured error identity to the parent.
signals.summary_zh: 子 Agent 不再因首次模型调用 404 立即终止，而是沿用会话回退模型链，并向父 Agent 返回结构化错误身份。

signals.title: Claude Code background sessions detect dead terminal hosts and expose restartable failure state
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 后台会话可识别终端宿主死亡并暴露可重启失败状态
signals.summary: Background sessions that lose their terminal host now fail within seconds with a reason and can be restarted instead of remaining indefinitely in an opening state.
signals.summary_zh: 后台会话失去终端宿主后会在数秒内以明确原因失败，并允许重启，不再长期停留在 opening 状态。

signals.title: Claude Code resumed cloud sessions now report work lost across container restarts
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 云会话在容器重启后恢复时会报告丢失工作
signals.summary: When a cloud-session container restarts between turns while background work is active, the resumed session reports the lost work instead of silently continuing.
signals.summary_zh: 云会话在后台任务运行期间发生跨轮次容器重启后，恢复会话会明确报告丢失的工作，而不是静默继续。

signals.title: Claude Code self-hosted runners no longer report running before the agent process starts
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 自托管 Runner 不再在 Agent 进程启动前提前报告 running
signals.summary: Runner state now waits for Claude Code startup, preventing downstream clients from acting on a false running state and issuing premature waiting-for-input notifications.
signals.summary_zh: Runner 状态现在等待 Claude Code 真正启动，避免下游客户端基于虚假的 running 状态提前发出等待输入通知。

signals.title: Claude Code tells the model when configured MCP servers fail to connect
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 会向模型显式告知已配置 MCP Server 连接失败
signals.summary: For Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and telemetry-disabled sessions, configured MCP connection failures are surfaced to Claude rather than being misinterpreted as missing tools.
signals.summary_zh: 在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 以及关闭遥测的会话中，已配置 MCP 的连接失败会显式暴露给 Claude，避免被误判为工具不存在。

signals.title: Claude Code organization sign-in enforcement now fails closed when managed settings are unreadable
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 组织登录强制策略在托管设置不可读时改为 fail-closed
signals.summary: Organization sign-in enforcement exits at startup when administrator-managed settings cannot be read, even if less-authoritative host or user registry settings exist.
signals.summary_zh: 当管理员托管设置不可读取时，组织登录强制策略会在启动阶段退出，即使存在权限较低的宿主或用户注册表设置也不继续运行。

signals.title: Codex Guardian accepts invoked user skills as authorization evidence only from verified trusted roots
signals.title_zh: Codex Guardian 仅对经验证可信根目录中的已调用用户 Skill 接受授权证据
signals.summary: Guardian records explicit and implicit user-skill invocation, passes only canonical verified paths under trusted user roots, and keeps repository skills or escaping symlinks untrusted.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian 记录显式与隐式用户 Skill 调用，只传递可信用户根目录下经验证的规范路径，并继续把仓库 Skill 和逃逸符号链接视为不可信。

signals.title: Codex attaches verified account access context only to eligible plugin MCP calls
signals.title_zh: Codex 仅向符合条件的插件 MCP 调用附加经验证的账户访问上下文
signals.summary: Account-bound entitlement context is host-owned, timeout-bounded and attached only to narrowly eligible local read-only plugin MCP calls; caller-supplied context is rejected.
signals.summary_zh: 账户绑定的 entitlement 上下文由宿主拥有、受超时约束，并只附加到严格符合条件的本地只读插件 MCP 调用；调用方自带上下文会被拒绝。

signals.title: Codex filesystem policy matching moves to URI-native semantics and fails closed on ambiguous boundaries
signals.title_zh: Codex 文件系统策略匹配改用 URI 原生语义，并在边界歧义时 fail-closed
signals.summary: Filesystem policy entries and special roots are resolved as PathUri values using executor path conventions, with validated components and fail-closed handling for ambiguous containment boundaries.
signals.summary_zh: 文件系统策略条目与特殊根目录改为按执行器路径约定解析为 PathUri，并使用经验证的组件判断包含关系；边界歧义时直接 fail-closed。

signals.title: Codex managed proxy listener handoff removes filesystem socket exposure and binds bridge lifetime to the sandbox
signals.title_zh: Codex 托管代理 Listener 交接移除文件系统 Socket 暴露，并将桥接生命周期绑定到 Sandbox
signals.summary: Linux managed networking transfers loopback listeners over anonymous socket pairs, validates descriptors, isolates bootstrap channels per sandbox and closes active upstream connections on cancellation.
signals.summary_zh: Linux 托管网络通过匿名 Socket Pair 转移回环 Listener，校验描述符、按 Sandbox 隔离启动通道，并在取消时关闭活跃上游连接。

signals.title: Codex standalone tool outputs become durable turn inputs and survive thread resume
signals.title_zh: Codex 独立 Tool Output 成为持久 Turn 输入并可跨 Thread Resume 保留
signals.summary: turn/start can accept named function-call outputs without user input, persist them as functionCallOutput items and include them in resumed thread history with validation limits.
signals.summary_zh: turn/start 可在没有用户输入时接收具名函数输出，将其持久化为 functionCallOutput，并在恢复线程历史时保留，同时执行输入校验与大小限制。

signals.title: Codex introduces fresh approval before writing input to escalated terminals
signals.title_zh: Codex 为向提权终端写入输入引入新的逐次审批
signals.summary: A feature-gated writeStdin approval path requires fresh approval before nonempty input is sent to an escalated terminal and revalidates process identity after approval.
signals.summary_zh: 新的 writeStdin 审批路径可要求在向提权终端发送非空输入前获得新审批，并在审批后重新核验进程身份。

signals.title: Codex exposes MCP call provenance to tool lifecycle extensions
signals.title_zh: Codex 向 Tool Lifecycle Extension 暴露 MCP 调用来源身份
signals.summary: Tool lifecycle callbacks receive model-visible MCP identity and source classification for connectors, configured servers and plugins, while the executable client remains hidden.
signals.summary_zh: Tool Lifecycle 回调可获得模型可见的 MCP 工具身份与来源分类，区分 Connector、配置 Server 与 Plugin，同时不暴露可执行客户端。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK rejects unpaired function outputs in Chat Completions
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在 Chat Completions 中拒绝未配对的函数输出
signals.summary: The Agents SDK now rejects function outputs that have no matching function call in the Chat Completions path, tightening conversation/tool state integrity.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 在 Chat Completions 路径中拒绝没有对应函数调用的函数输出，从而收紧对话与工具状态完整性。

signals.title: Gemini CLI hardens MCP OAuth metadata discovery against SSRF
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 加固 MCP OAuth 元数据发现以防止 SSRF
signals.summary: Gemini CLI merged a security fix preventing SSRF during MCP OAuth metadata discovery and authentication.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 合并了针对 MCP OAuth 元数据发现与认证阶段 SSRF 的安全修复。

signals.title: Google ADK reports unknown tool names to the model instead of raising out of the runtime
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将未知工具名反馈给模型，而不是从运行时直接抛出异常
signals.summary: An unknown tool name is converted into model-visible feedback rather than escaping as a runtime exception, preserving the agent loop's ability to recover.
signals.summary_zh: 未知工具名会转换为模型可见反馈，而不是作为运行时异常逸出，从而保留 Agent 循环自我恢复的机会。

signals.title: Google ADK fixes hot reload of changed agents
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 修复变更后 Agent 的热重载
signals.summary: ADK corrected agent reload behavior after an agent definition changes, reducing stale execution state during iterative development.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修复 Agent 定义变化后的重载行为，减少迭代开发中的陈旧执行状态。

signals.title: Google ADK normalizes session identifiers before duplicate checks
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在重复检查前规范化 Session ID
signals.summary: The in-memory session service now normalizes session_id before detecting duplicates, strengthening identity consistency in session state.
signals.summary_zh: 内存 Session Service 现在会在重复检测前规范化 session_id，从而加强会话状态中的身份一致性。

signals.title: Google ADK workflow retry policy now includes subclasses of configured retry exceptions
signals.title_zh: Google ADK Workflow Retry 策略现覆盖已配置重试异常的子类
signals.summary: Workflow retry classification now treats subclasses of configured retry exceptions as retryable, aligning runtime behavior with exception inheritance.
signals.summary_zh: Workflow 重试分类现在会把已配置重试异常的子类也视为可重试，使运行行为与异常继承关系一致。

signals.title: Google ADK ParallelAgent stops early only on escalation from a direct sub-agent
signals.title_zh: Google ADK ParallelAgent 仅在直接子 Agent 升级时提前结束
signals.summary: ParallelAgent early termination is now scoped to escalation by a direct sub-agent, tightening propagation boundaries in multi-agent control flow.
signals.summary_zh: ParallelAgent 的提前终止现在仅由直接子 Agent 的升级触发，收紧多 Agent 控制流中的升级传播边界。

signals.title: Google ADK prevents temporary-file cleanup failures from masking primary upload errors
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 防止临时文件清理失败掩盖主要上传错误
signals.summary: Cleanup of a temporary memory-upload file no longer replaces the original upload failure, preserving causal failure identity.
signals.summary_zh: Memory 上传临时文件的清理失败不再覆盖原始上传失败，从而保留真实的因果失败身份。

signals.title: Codex enables retained-image context budgeting by default during remote compaction
signals.title_zh: Codex 在远程 Compaction 中默认启用保留图片的上下文预算
signals.summary: Retained images are now charged against the remote compaction context budget by default and older images are trimmed as required.
signals.summary_zh: 远程 Compaction 现在默认把保留图片计入上下文预算，并在需要时裁剪较旧图片。
